llmAnalysis.summary: Plugin is a read-only usage dashboard with no IPC command parser, no dynamic code execution, and fixed bundled assets. The only executable is the bundled collector.sh run as ["bash", script] with no arguments; risk is limited to expected read of local auth.json/DB and HTTPS fetch to opencode.ai.
llmAnalysis.whatItDoes: Adds a bar widget that shows OpenCode Go quota as a percentage and highlights when usage is behind pace. Clicking expands a panel with 5h/weekly/monthly limit bars, reset countdowns, and a 7-day token history chart fetched via a background collector.
llmAnalysis.sequenceDiagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Panel as Panel.qml
    participant Service as Service.qml
    participant Collector as collector.sh
    participant API as opencode.ai
    participant DB as opencode.db
    User->>Panel: click/right-click or timer
    Panel->>Service: refresh()
    Service->>Collector: Process command ["bash", collectorScript]
    Collector->>DB: sqlite3 -readonly query recent tokens
    Collector->>API: curl Bearer $key https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage
    Collector-->>Service: JSON {status, rolling/weekly/monthly, recentDays}
    Service->>Service: Model.parseCollector() validate
    Service-->>Panel: update account/recentDays display

findings.reasoning: Resolves bundled collector.sh to an absolute path then executed as fixed command ["bash", root.collectorScript] at Service.qml:31. Path is a literal inside plugin bundle, no user input, no args to inject; execution is intentional and bounded.
findings.relatedCode: readonly property string collectorScript: decodeURIComponent(String(Qt.resolvedUrl("collector.sh")).replace(/^file:\/\//,"")) -> collector.command = ["bash", root.collectorScript]
findings.executableContext: collector.sh is the plugin's bundled collector: reads $HOME/.local/share/opencode/auth.json (jq .["opencode-go"].key), curl -m10 to https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage with Bearer token, and sqlite3 -readonly query on opencode.db for last 7 days tokens/cost; takes no arguments, no sanitization needed
